title: BDLB Lesson Plan
description: Schema for a Backward-Design Lesson Builder lesson_plan.json artifact produced by the backward-design-analyst sub-agent. Validates the three-tier (easy/medium/hard) plan derived from a single STAAR-style seed question.

lesson_goal.description: One-sentence statement of what the student should be able to do after completing this lesson.

tek_alignment.description: Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills code, e.g. '3.4K' or '5.3'.

rigor_anchor.description: The hard tier's rigor must match the seed question; this field is fixed to the literal string 'hard'.

tiers.description: Three-tier definition: easy is two rigor levels below seed, medium one below, hard matches seed.

scaffolding_logic.description: Plain-language explanation of how easy scaffolds into medium scaffolds into hard.

thinking_process.description: Ordered list of cognitive steps a student takes to solve a hard-tier item. Minimum 3 steps.

seed_question_ref.description: Relative or absolute path to the seed question JSON file produced by seed-question-extractor.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time when this lesson_plan.json was generated.

description.description: Short prose description of what items at this tier look like.

cognitive_demand.description: Cognitive demand level for this tier.
